about_text:
{disclaimer}

No Pokémon data comes with the add-on: names and facts are fetched from PokéAPI (pokeapi.co) when they are first needed, and kept on your computer for 30 days so PokéAPI is asked as little as possible. The weather comes from Open-Meteo, for your home rounded to about 1 kilometre; only that rounded point is kept. A map link or a city is looked up once, when you press Find this place (Google for a short link, Open-Meteo for a city, OpenStreetMap for the town's name). Looking around yourself works once every 20 minutes. When Pokémon come by themselves, the weather at home is checked every half hour outside your quiet hours. The sounds are made for this add-on. Wild Encounters is free, with nothing to buy.
